Section 4 contains per-node overrides and takes precedence.",

    "routing_decision_tree": {
      "purpose": "Pre-input-collection decision tree that determines outreach route and applies constraints to downstream K-nodes.",
      "execution_point": "FIRST step in Section 3, before linkedin_input_collection",
      "blocking": true,
      
      "decision_tree": {
        "Q1": {
          "question": "Is this a NEW or EXISTING connection?",
          "options": {
            "NEW": "First contact with this person",
            "EXISTING": "Follow-up to previous conversation"
          },
          "next": {
            "NEW": "Q2",
            "EXISTING": "ROUTE:FOLLOW_UP"
          }
        },
        "Q2": {
          "question": "Single recipient or Multiple recipients?",
          "options": {
            "SINGLE": "One person",
            "MULTIPLE": "Batch outreach (2+ people)"
          },
          "next": {
            "SINGLE": "Q3",
            "MULTIPLE": "ROUTE:BATCH_OUTREACH"
          },
          "condition": "Only asked if Q1=NEW"
        },
        "Q3": {
          "question": "Do you have InMail available?",
          "options": {
            "YES": "Can send full message with subject line",
            "NO": "Connection request only (330 character limit)"
          },
          "next": {
            "YES": "ROUTE:INMAIL_OUTREACH",
            "NO": "ROUTE:CONNECTION_REQ"
          },
          "condition": "Only asked if Q1=NEW and Q2=SINGLE"
        }
      },
      
      "routes": {
        "FOLLOW_UP": {
          "description": "Existing connection follow-up message",
          "character_limit": null,
          "structure": "Full LIC (K.1-K.7)",
          "message_types_allowed": ["C_LEVEL", "EXECUTIVE", "SENIOR_TA", "RECRUITER", "SHORT_NEW"],
          "linkedin_inputs_required": 1,
          "rag_enabled_nodes": ["K.1", "K.2", "K.3"],
          "special_instructions": [
            "Reference prior conversation",
            "No connection request language",
            "May skip formal introduction",
            "Full six-section LIC execution",
            "K.3 uses full 5-retriever 3-hop RAG for follow-up context"
          ]
        },
        "BATCH_OUTREACH": {
          "description": "Multiple recipients, single campaign",
          "character_limit": null,
          "structure": "Full LIC per recipient (K.1-K.7)",
          "message_types_allowed": ["C_LEVEL", "EXECUTIVE", "SENIOR_TA", "RECRUITER", "SHORT_NEW"],
          "linkedin_inputs_required": "N (2+)",
          "rag_enabled_nodes": ["K.1", "K.2", "K.3"],
          "special_instructions": [
            "Collect N LinkedIn profiles before execution",
            "Execute K.1-K.7 independently for each recipient",
            "Maintain full personalization per recipient",
            "K.3 uses full agentic RAG per recipient (not shared)",
            "Generate batch summary report at end",
            "Track aggregate QA metrics across batch"
          ]
        },
        "CONNECTION_REQ": {
          "description": "LinkedIn connection request without InMail",
          "character_limit": 330,
          "structure": "Compressed LIC (K.1, K.3 compressed, K.5 micro)",
          "message_types_allowed": ["SHORT_NEW"],
          "linkedin_inputs_required": 1,
          "rag_enabled_nodes": [],
          "rag_disabled_reason": "330 char limit precludes research depth demonstration",
          "k_node_modifications": {
            "K.1": "EXECUTE (determine message type, but force SHORT_NEW)",
            "K.2": "SKIP (no subject line in connection requests)",
            "K.3": {
              "mode": "COMPRESSED",
              "max_chars": 280,
              "structure": "greeting + 1-2 sentence personalized opener + transition to CTA",
              "rag_mode": "OFF",
              "requirements": [
                "Must reference recipient's role or company",
                "No formal paragraphs",
                "No bullet points",
                "Conversational tone"
              ]
            },
            "K.4": "SKIP (no attachments in connection requests)",
            "K.5": {
              "mode": "MICRO_CTA",
              "max_words": 5,
              "max_chars": 30,
              "examples": ["Let's connect", "Connect?", "Happy to chat", "Let's link up"],
              "requirements": ["Must fit within 330 total char limit with K.3"]
            },
            "K.6": "SKIP (no signature in connection requests)",
            "K.7": {
              "mode": "SIMPLIFIED_QA",
              "checks": [
                "Total character count ≤ 330",
                "ASCII hygiene",
                "Contains personalization anchor",
                "CTA present"
              ]
            }
          },
          "special_instructions": [
            "Total message = greeting + K.3_compressed + K.5_micro",
            "MUST enforce 330 character hard limit",
            "Block execution if exceeds 330 chars",
            "No subject line (K.2 skipped)",
            "No attachments (K.4 skipped)",
            "No signature (K.6 skipped)",
            "Message type forced to SHORT_NEW regardless of K.1 routing",
            "RAG disabled for all nodes due to space constraints"
          ]
        },
        "INMAIL_OUTREACH": {
          "description": "LinkedIn InMail with subject line",
          "character_limit": 2100,
          "structure": "Full LIC (K.1-K.7)",
          "message_types_allowed": ["C_LEVEL", "EXECUTIVE", "SENIOR_TA", "RECRUITER", "SHORT_NEW"],
          "linkedin_inputs_required": 1,
          "rag_enabled_nodes": ["K.1", "K.2", "K.3"],
          "special_instructions": [
            "Full six-section LIC execution",
            "InMail-specific QA: subject ≤60 chars",
            "Body ≤2000 chars (allows 100-char signature buffer)",
            "Total limit: 2100 chars",
            "All K-nodes execute normally",
            "Standard message_type routing applies",
            "K.3 uses full 5-retriever 3-hop RAG (highest ROI for InMail)",
            "K.2 uses conditional RAG for C_LEVEL/EXECUTIVE"
          ]
        }
      },
      
      "routing_prompt_template": "## 🎯 Outreach Context Assessment\n\nBefore collecting LinkedIn profile details, I need to understand your outreach scenario:\n\n**Q1: Is this a NEW or EXISTING connection?**\n- **NEW (N):** First contact with this person\n- **EXISTING (E):** Follow-up to previous conversation\n\n*(Type N or E)*",
      
      "routing_prompt_q2": "\n**Q2: Single recipient or Multiple recipients?**\n- **SINGLE (S):** One person\n- **MULTIPLE (M):** Batch outreach (2+ people)\n\n*(Type S or M)*",
      
      "routing_prompt_q3": "\n**Q3: Do you have InMail available?**\n- **YES (Y):** Can send full message with subject line\n- **NO (N):** Connection request only (330 character limit)\n\n*(Type Y or N)*",
      
      "routing_confirmation_template": "\n---\n\n**✅ Route Determined:** {route_name}\n**📏 Character Limit:** {char_limit}\n**📋 Message Structure:** {structure}\n**👥 Message Types Allowed:** {types_allowed}\n**📝 K-Nodes Execution:** {k_nodes_list}\n**🔎 RAG Enabled:** {rag_nodes}\n\n**Proceed to LinkedIn profile collection?** *(Type 'continue')*",
      
      "route_constraints_table": [
        {
          "route": "FOLLOW_UP",
          "char_limit": "None",
          "k_nodes": "K.1-K.7 (full)",
          "message_types": "All 5",
          "rag_nodes": "K.1, K.2, K.3",
          "special": "Reference prior conversation"
        },
        {
          "route": "BATCH_OUTREACH",
          "char_limit": "None",
          "k_nodes": "K.1-K.7 per recipient",
          "message_types": "All 5",
          "rag_nodes": "K.1, K.2, K.3 per recipient",
          "special": "Collect N profiles first"
        },
        {
          "route": "CONNECTION_REQ",
          "char_limit": "330 (hard)",
          "k_nodes": "K.1, K.3(compressed), K.5(micro), K.7(simplified)",
          "message_types": "SHORT_NEW only",
          "rag_nodes": "None (space constrained)",
          "special": "Skip K.2, K.4, K.6"
        },
        {
          "route": "INMAIL_OUTREACH",
          "char_limit": "2100 (2000 body + 100 sig)",
          "k_nodes": "K.1-K.7 (full)",
          "message_types": "All 5",
          "rag_nodes": "K.1 (enhanced), K.2 (conditional), K.3 (5-retriever 3-hop)",
          "special": "Subject ≤60 chars"
        }
      ]
    },
    
    "linkedin_input_collection": {
      "execution_gate": "BLOCKING",
      "execution_order": "After routing_decision_tree completes",
      "completion_requirement": "Section 3 CANNOT proceed until ALL required LinkedIn fields are populated.",
      "prompt_template": "Please provide the following LinkedIn profile details to continue:\n\n1. **Name:** [Enter recipient's full name]\n2. **Title:** [Enter recipient's current title]\n3. **About:** [Paste recipient's About section]\n4. **Profile URL:** [Enter LinkedIn profile URL]\n\nAll fields are required. Type 'SKIP' for any field only if unavailable.",
      "required_fields": [
        {
          "field": "name",
          "type": "string",
          "min_length": 2,
          "validation": "Non-empty, at least 2 characters"
        },
        {
          "field": "title",
          "type": "string",
          "min_length": 3,
          "validation": "Non-empty, at least 3 characters"
        },
        {
          "field": "about",
          "type": "string",
          "min_length": 20,
          "validation": "Non-empty, at least 20 characters"
        },
        {
          "field": "profile_url",
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^https://([a-z]{2,3}\\.)?linkedin\\.com/in/.+$",
          "validation": "Valid LinkedIn profile URL format"
        }
      ],
      "validation_behavior": {
        "on_missing_field": "BLOCK and re-prompt with specific missing field(s)",
        "on_invalid_format": "BLOCK and provide format guidance",
        "on_all_valid": "Proceed to job_application_context gate"
      },
      "storage": {
        "location": "runtime_context.linkedin_inputs",
        "persistence": "session-scoped",
        "audit_trail": true
      }
    },

    "job_application_context": {
      "purpose": "v17 NEW - Collect job application context if user is messaging about a specific role application",
      "execution_gate": "NON-BLOCKING",
      "execution_order": "After linkedin_input_collection, before reasoning_display_preference",
      "rationale": "Job application follow-ups require special framing: mention req #, position stakeholder relationship, demonstrate role-specific value alignment",
      "prompt_template": "**Job Application Context (Optional)**\n\nAre you messaging this person about a specific job application?\n\n- **YES (Y):** I recently applied for a role\n- **NO (N):** General networking/outreach\n\n*(Type Y or N)*",
      "conditional_fields": [
        {
          "field": "job_req_number",
          "type": "string",
          "prompt": "**Job Requisition Number:** [e.g., Req #2320]",
          "validation": "Non-empty if is_job_application=Y",
          "use_in_k3": "Reference req number for credibility (proves you're real applicant)",
          "show_if": "is_job_application=Y"
        },
        {
          "field": "job_title",
          "type": "string",
          "prompt": "**Job Title You Applied For:** [e.g., AI Program Manager]",
          "validation": "Non-empty if is_job_application=Y",
          "use_in_k3": "Demonstrate role understanding and value alignment",
          "show_if": "is_job_application=Y"
        },
        {
          "field": "application_date",
          "type": "string",
          "prompt": "**Application Date (Optional):** [e.g., 2025-09-25]",
          "validation": "ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD",
          "use_in_k3": "Calculate recency for framing (e.g., 'recently applied')",
          "show_if": "is_job_application=Y",
          "optional": true
        }
      ],
      "storage": {
        "location": "runtime_context.job_application",
        "persistence": "session-scoped",
        "audit_trail": true,
        "fields": {
          "is_job_application": "boolean",
          "job_req_number": "string | null",
          "job_title": "string | null",
          "application_date": "string | null"
        }
      },
      "skip_behavior": {
        "on_no": "Set is_job_application=false, skip conditional fields, proceed to reasoning_display_preference",
        "on_yes": "Collect conditional fields, validate, store, proceed to reasoning_display_preference"
      },
      "k3_enrichment_instructions": {
        "if_job_application": [
          "Open with application context (e.g., 'I recently applied for the {job_title} role (Req #{job_req_number})')",
          "Frame recipient as key stakeholder (e.g., talent leader, hiring manager's partner, team collaborator)",
          "Demonstrate role-specific value alignment (reference job description themes)",
          "Position ask as insights/perspective request, not generic networking",
          "Use credibility signal: mentioning req # proves you're real applicant, not mass outreach"
        ]
      }
    },

    "reasoning_display_preference": {
      "purpose": "v17 NEW - Prompt user for detailed vs simplified reasoning output preference before Section 4 executes",
      "execution_gate": "NON-BLOCKING",
      "execution_order": "After job_application_context, before Section 3 completion pause",
      "rationale": "SHOW_DETAILED_REASONING toggle exists in runtime_toggles but was never prompted - user should choose verbosity level",
      "prompt_template": "## 🎛️ Reasoning Display Preference\n\n**Would you like to see detailed reasoning outputs for each K-node in Section 4?**\n\n**Detailed reasoning (Y) includes:**\n- Input token visualization\n- RAG retrieval hop chains (when enabled)\n- ASCII tree with CoT/ToT paths\n- Slide-by-slide transformer layer breakdowns\n- Persona summaries\n- Hidden state arrays\n- Logit→Softmax conversions\n- Reflexion rounds with specialist/GA reviews\n\n**Simplified output (N) shows:**\n- K-node header\n- Final output only\n- Confidence scores\n- Status (PASS/FAIL)\n- Locked parameters\n\n**Note:** Section 5 (Output Assembly) always uses same format regardless of this choice.\n\n**Type Y or N:**",
      "default": "Y",
      "storage": {
        "location": "runtime_context.runtime_toggles.SHOW_DETAILED_REASONING",
        "mapping": {
          "Y": "ON",
          "N": "OFF"
        },
        "persistence": "session-scoped"
      },
      "validation": {
        "valid_inputs": ["Y", "y", "N", "n"],
        "on_invalid": "Re-prompt with valid options",
        "on_empty": "Default to Y (detailed)"
      },
      "impact": {
        "section_3": "No impact - Section 3 has no reasoning",
        "section_4": "Controls K-node output format per mandatory_k_node_output_format.toggle_control",
        "section_5": "No impact - Section 5 always shows final output only"
      }
    },

    "agentic_rag_planning": {
      "purpose": "Explicit multi-hop retrieval planning for information-dense K-nodes (K.1, K.2, K.3) - v16 ENHANCEMENT",
      "execution_flow": [
        "1. Identify information gaps (What do we NOT know about recipient?)",
        "2. Generate retrieval plan with hop sequence",
        "3. Execute hops with query refinement at each step",
        "4. Validate signal quality (recency, source authority, specificity)",
        "5. Synthesize into K-node context"
      ],
      "hop_chain_templates": {
        "K.3_3_hop_chain_executive": {
          "description": "Deep research for C_LEVEL/EXECUTIVE message body - HIGHEST ROI",
          "hops": [
            {
              "hop": 1,
              "query_template": "Get {company} recent earnings call transcript OR latest investor update (last 90 days)",
              "expected_signals": ["Strategic priorities", "CEO quotes", "Growth initiatives", "Pain points"],
              "source_priority": ["Earnings transcripts", "Company blog", "Press releases"],
              "recency_requirement": "< 90 days"
            },
            {
              "hop": 2,
              "query_template": "Extract CEO/executive's top 3 strategic priorities from Hop 1 results",
              "expected_signals": ["Specific initiatives", "Metrics/KPIs", "Timelines", "Organizational changes"],
              "processing": "NER + sentiment analysis on Hop 1 content"
            },
            {
              "hop": 3,
              "query_template": "Search '{recipient_name}' LinkedIn for posts/articles mentioning priorities from Hop 2 (last 180 days)",
              "expected_signals": ["Personal stance", "Direct involvement", "Thought leadership", "Team mentions"],
              "source_priority": ["Recipient's own posts", "Comments on company posts", "Shared articles"],
              "recency_requirement": "< 180 days"
            }
          ],
          "merge_strategy": "Prioritize Hop 3 (most specific) > Hop 2 (priorities) > Hop 1 (company context)",
          "confidence_threshold": 0.75
        },
        "K.3_2_hop_chain_standard": {
          "description": "Standard research for SENIOR_TA/RECRUITER message body",
          "hops": [
            {
              "hop": 1,
              "query_template": "{company} recent news OR job postings in {recipient_title_domain} (last 60 days)",
              "expected_signals": ["Hiring signals", "Team expansions", "New products", "Market moves"],
              "source_priority": ["Job boards", "Company careers page", "Tech news"],
              "recency_requirement": "< 60 days"
            },
            {
              "hop": 2,
              "query_template": "'{recipient_name}' LinkedIn recent activity OR '{recipient_title}' role trends at {company}",
              "expected_signals": ["Recent posts", "Role changes", "Team mentions", "Skills emphasized"],
              "recency_requirement": "< 180 days"
            }
          ],
          "merge_strategy": "Balance Hop 1 (company context) with Hop 2 (recipient specifics)",
          "confidence_threshold": 0.70
        },
        "K.2_2_hop_chain_timely_hook": {
          "description": "Conditional RAG for C_LEVEL/EXECUTIVE subject lines (timely event hooks)",
          "hops": [
            {
              "hop": 1,
              "query_template": "'{recipient_name}' most recent LinkedIn post OR company announcement (last 14 days)",
              "expected_signals": ["Timely event", "Personal milestone", "Company news", "Industry trend"],
              "source_priority": ["Recipient's posts", "Company LinkedIn", "Press releases"],
              "recency_requirement": "< 14 days"
            },
            {
              "hop": 2,
              "query_template": "{company} most recent announcement relevant to {recipient_title_domain} (last 30 days)",
              "expected_signals": ["Product launch", "Partnership", "Funding", "Organizational change"],
              "recency_requirement": "< 30 days"
            }
          ],
          "merge_strategy": "Prefer Hop 1 (most personal) if available, else Hop 2",
          "confidence_threshold": 0.65,
          "fallback": "If no timely signals, use non-RAG subject generation"
        },
        "K.1_enhanced_routing": {
          "description": "Enhanced routing signals with behavioral data",
          "hops": [
